data.headline: Smithtown adopts extension of Gyrodyne preliminary approval

claims.text: The Smithtown Planning Board agenda records an adopted request to retroactively extend Gyrodyne LLC’s conditional preliminary approval for 180 days, expiring March 30, 2027.

citation.quote: Adopted 1. #1178 Gyrodyne LLC, St. James (4-0) Request: To retroactively extend the conditional preliminary approval for a Desmond Ryan period of 180 days so as to expire on March 30, 2027.

claims.text: The company says it expects to receive and respond to comments before scheduling a hearing with possible final approval in the first quarter of 2027, subject to the remaining regulatory process.

citation.quote: Once the Town of Smithtown application is filed we expect to receive and respond to comments prior to scheduling a hearing with possible final approval in the first quarter of 2027 (assuming comments are received and responded to promptly), all of which are subject to and contingent on the remaining regulatory process.

claims.text: The filing makes the final Town of Smithtown subdivision application contingent on the owners of lot two’s approval.

citation.quote: We anticipate submitting a final Town of Smithtown subdivision application in the third quarter of 2026 contingent on the owners of lot two’s approval.
